review: Independent read-only V19 source and focused-test review
checks: The adapter calls its base perception once, reads onboard tracker observations and existing adapter diagnostics, and performs no additional sensor query or hidden-state access.
A transferred row must exactly equal a current raw-cluster coordinate and a current memory coordinate, and must not equal any coordinate in an older memory batch.
Fresh confirmed matched detections require unique current scan/source/cluster identity, current positive appear evidence and the existing minimum violation count.
The existing fitted-hull extent gate, full longitudinal extent, measured-motion observation/end-point/residual certificate and unique age-zero published synthetic hypothesis are all required.
The published hypothesis position and velocity must equal the current diagnostic values, and the observed cluster must fit inside its oriented hull plus the existing tolerance.
Overlapping or malformed other raw-source geometry prevents transfer. Missing provenance or coasting/stale evidence retains static points.
Only the returned snapshot point array changes; older memory, underlying memory arrays, tracks, target views, policy observations, thresholds and action selection are preserved.
source_owned_points=False retains the V16 perception object and parent controller behavior; V18 heading memory is not implicitly enabled.

Tests cover exact one-ULP nonmatching, older equal rows, static neighbours, duplicate/missing/stale/ambiguous evidence, fit and certificate failures, nonmutation, hidden-access guards and disabled delegation.
The saved CRS04 test reconstructs a conservative superset of older memory and checks nine exact current rows removed with 49 retained; it does not run an episode or establish a rescue.
limitations: A mixed cluster can still include an unrecognised static surface despite the existing motion and hull gates; association is an engineering hypothesis, not proved ownership.
Exact coordinate matching and retention of all older equal coordinates can conservatively transfer few or no rows.
Older target returns remain static until the inherited clearing/expiry logic removes them; this adapter does not retroactively reassign memory.
Missing internal diagnostics normally prevent transfer; malformed internal types may raise rather than provide a general untrusted-input recovery path.
Source review and saved-state checks do not establish episode improvement, absence of regressions or a safety guarantee.

verification.focused_test_scope: 32 synthetic checks and one optional saved-trace perception check; no episodes
